Question ID: CW_U05_L04_GP_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.CW.PUB.02

Draft Excerpt: I waited outside the rehearsal room. The music stopped. I raised my hand to knock, then lowered it. The writer wants a poem that emphasizes hesitation. Which format choice best fits?

answer.text: A. Use line breaks around "raised my hand" and "lowered it" so the reader pauses with the speaker.

feedback.text: Correct. The format choice supports pacing and meaning.

answer.text: B. Put the entire draft in one long line.

feedback.text: Incorrect. One long line may reduce the pause that shows hesitation.

answer.text: C. Add random spaces between every word.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Random spacing distracts the reader and does not clearly support meaning.

answer.text: D. Remove all punctuation and format choices.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Removing all control can make the piece harder to read.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: CW_U05_L04_GP_Q02

MLA Standard: MLA.CW.PUB.02

Draft Excerpt: "Come in" Mara said but she did not open the door. Which prose-story revision best improves publication quality?

answer.text: A. come in mara said but she did not open the door

feedback.text: Incorrect. This removes punctuation and capitalization, which weakens readability.

answer.text: B. COME IN MARA SAID BUT SHE DID NOT OPEN THE DOORfor this item

feedback.text: Incorrect. All capitals do not create clear prose formatting.

answer.text: C. Come in. Mara. Door. Said.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This fragments the sentence and makes meaning less clear.

answer.text: D. "Come in," Mara said, but she did not open the door.

feedback.text: Correct. The punctuation and sentence control make the dialogue clear.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: CW_U05_L04_GP_Q03

MLA Standard: MLA.CW.PUB.02

Script context: Mara speaks while keeping one hand on the door. Which format best fits a script?

answer.text: A. Mara was nervous in a paragraph with no speaker label.

feedback.text: Incorrect. A script needs clear speaker labels for performance reading.

answer.text: B. MARA (keeping one hand on the door): Do not come in yet.

feedback.text: Correct. The character label and stage direction support script format and meaning.

answer.text: C. Do not come in yet, someone said somewhere.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This hides the speaker and does not use script format.

answer.text: D. A decorative title with no dialogue.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Decoration does not replace format features needed for a script.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: CW_U05_L04_GP_Q04

MLA Standard: MLA.CW.PUB.02

A writer says, "I changed the spacing because it looked creative." What is the best revision of that explanation?

answer.text: A. I changed the spacing because all poems need strange spacing.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This is a false rule and does not explain the effect.

answer.text: B. I changed the spacing because my friend told me to.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This does not explain how the format helps the reader.

answer.text: C. I placed the final phrase on its own line so the reader pauses before the speaker's decision.

feedback.text: Correct. This names the format choice and explains the reader effect.

answer.text: D. I changed the spacing for no reason.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Publication choices should be purposeful. This choice is not supported by the provided context or lesson skill; choose the option grounded in the prompt.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: CW_U05_L04_GP_Q05

MLA Standard: MLA.CW.PUB.02

Format check: A nonfiction reflection has one paragraph that combines three different moments. What should the writer check first?

answer.text: A. Whether paragraph breaks would separate the moments and improve clarity.

feedback.text: Correct. Format-specific quality means the structure should help the reader understand the piece.

answer.text: B. Whether the title can be a random symbol.

feedback.text: Incorrect. The issue is organization and reader tracking, not decoration.

answer.text: C. Whether the piece can ignore paragraphing.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Paragraphing helps readers follow shifts in thought or time.

answer.text: D. Whether every sentence should be deleted.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Deleting everything is not a targeted format revision.
